review_evidence: README identifies NNG4 as the Lean 4 Natural Number Game, a theorem-proving game whose levels are authored and checked as Lean source.
The hydrated snapshot has 182 Lean files; direct declaration scan found theorem, lemma, axiom, and example statements throughout the game levels, including the proposition/function worlds.

Files such as Game/Levels/OldProposition/FuncProgram.lean contain actual definitions and proofs (double_eq_two_mul, pred_succ, succ_inj and related results), so the repository is substantive pedagogical formal prior art.
summary: Retain the Lean 4 Natural Number Game as a checked pedagogical corpus of arithmetic definitions, statements, axioms, exercises, and proofs.
